takamol.title: Financial Consultant
takamol.blurb: Semi-government technology and consulting group operating national labour-market digital platforms (Qiwa, Musaned, Ajeer) used by employers across Saudi Arabia.
bullets: Support the finance function across the monthly close, management reporting and the full reconciliation cycle (GL, AP/AR, accruals, prepayments, fixed assets and bank), producing audit-ready schedules and variance, cash-flow and working-capital analysis for management.

Prepare and review VAT and Withholding Tax positions, Zakat and Income Tax requirements; reconcile declared figures to the general ledger and prepare the documentation and responses required by ZATCA.

Detect and correct accounting misstatements before financial statements are issued — misclassified revenue and expenses, unrecorded accruals, incorrect VAT/WHT treatment and unreconciled control accounts — keeping external-audit adjustments at immaterial levels.
Reconcile high-volume, transaction-based platform revenue and receivables, tracing differences between operational platform data and the general ledger to source.
Identify process gaps in the reporting cycle, standardise accounting workflows and closing procedures, and coordinate with stakeholders to close reporting and compliance issues.

Build formula-driven Excel models and reconciliation schedules with embedded control totals and integrity checks, replacing manual hard-coded workbooks, and apply AI tools to research accounting standards and ZATCA guidance and to review documents and correspondence.

binsalamah.title: Bookkeeping Department Manager
binsalamah.company: Bin Salamah & Al-Zamil Certified Public Accountants
binsalamah.blurb: Licensed Saudi certified public accountants and audit firm.

Review client VAT and Withholding Tax returns before submission, confirming that declared figures reconcile to the underlying books and that supporting documentation meets ZATCA requirements.

Set the department's bookkeeping standards — chart-of-accounts structures, posting rules, closing checklists and review procedures — and perform quality control on client files before release to the client or to audit.

Owned VAT and WHT compliance end to end — return preparation, reconciliation to the GL, supporting documentation and responses to ZATCA — with no filing penalties during tenure.
Prepared annual financial statements and Zakat filings and coordinated the external audit: supporting schedules, sample requests and resolution of audit findings.

Introduced review and verification procedures across purchasing, payments and inventory that reduced recurring posting errors and improved record accuracy; produced rolling cash-flow forecasts guiding payment prioritisation and liquidity decisions.

accounting_manager.evidence_en: At Rashof Company I led a team of up to 15 across the full accounting cycle for a SAR 60 million business and cut the monthly close from 10 to 5 working days. At Takamol I currently own the reconciliation cycle and audit-ready schedules for a semi-government group, and I have caught and corrected more than SAR 1.5 million of misstatements before they reached the auditor.
accounting_manager.evidence_ar: في شركة رشوف قُدت فريقاً من 15 موظفاً عبر الدورة المحاسبية الكاملة لنشاط بحجم 60 مليون ريال، وخفّضت إقفال الشهر من 10 إلى 5 أيام عمل. وفي تكامل أتولى حالياً دورة التسويات والجداول الجاهزة للمراجعة لمجموعة شبه حكومية، وقد اكتشفت وصحّحت أخطاء محاسبية تجاوزت 1.5 مليون ريال قبل وصولها إلى المراجع الخارجي.

tax_zakat.tagline: VAT · WHT · Zakat · Income Tax | SOCPA VAT Specialist
tax_zakat.summary_rest: Prepares and reviews returns for multiple entities, reconciles declared figures to the general ledger, assembles the supporting documentation, and handles ZATCA queries, audits and assessments. Combines that with a financial-reporting background that makes tax positions defensible against the underlying books. Experienced across semi-government, healthcare, contracting and multi-entity commercial environments, ERP-driven finance operations (Odoo, Oracle, Dynamics) and advanced Excel modelling, with applied use of AI tools to research standards and tax guidance and review documents.
tax_zakat.evidence_en: I file and review more than 40 VAT and Withholding Tax returns a year alongside Zakat and Income Tax declarations, with a 100% on-time record and no penalties. I reconcile every declared figure to the general ledger, prepare the documentation ZATCA asks for, and have handled its queries, audits and assessments directly. I hold the SOCPA VAT Specialist certificate.
tax_zakat.evidence_ar: أُعدّ وأراجع أكثر من 40 إقرار ضريبة قيمة مضافة واستقطاع سنوياً إلى جانب إقرارات الزكاة وضريبة الدخل، بسجل التزام 100% دون أي غرامات. أطابق كل رقم مُعلن مع دفتر الأستاذ العام، وأجهّز المستندات التي تطلبها هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك، وتعاملت مباشرة مع استفساراتها وفحوصها وربوطها. وأحمل شهادة أخصائي ضريبة القيمة المضافة من الهيئة السعودية للمراجعين والمحاسبين.
